mobbin:7db28eda-b3e6-4948-ae78-198c4bc7d.summary: From Home favorites, the user opens Devices, scans room Groups and a device list, and sees health states ranging from unresponsive to Online/On-Off.
steps: Devices — room Groups + Device is unresponsive
steal: Groups carousel by room (Bedroom) above the flat device list (step 2) — jump by place before scanning endpoints.
Failure state: red dot + 'Device is unresponsive' under the device name (step 2) — health problem is visible without opening the device.
Binary On/Off pill on controllable endpoints vs Offline/Online text on always-on devices (steps 3–4) — status shape matches device type.
Map-pin affordance with 'Set up map view…' tip (step 2) — floor-plan glance as an alternate overview.
avoid: Dashed 'Shop' / Suggested Favorite category cards (steps 1–2) — clutter the health overview with commerce empty-states.
mobbin:7db28eda-b3e6-4948-ae78-198c4bc7d.fit: Informs Center Overview / scheduled self-test outside SRV: room-grouped device list with unresponsive vs Online/On-Off — not the Annotation/Transcript right panel.

mobbin:4a2af2e6-86bb-4af2-a8cf-dc106008e.summary: From Communication, the user opens Announce, composes via text, voice, or sound presets, sends, and gets a confirmation that the message reached all supported devices.
steps: Communication — Announce entry among Drop In / Call
Announcement — type or mic + preset chips (Keyboard)
Announcement — Sounds library with play buttons
Success — Announced to all devices + New Announcement
steal: Announce vs Drop In as separate top actions (step 1) — one-way broadcast vs live intercom are not the same control.
Keyboard / Sounds / Popular mode tabs under one compose surface (steps 2–3) — type, voice, or cue without leaving the sheet.
One-tap preset chips + Add Sounds list with preview play (steps 2–3) — stock cues for common room prompts.
Post-send confirmation 'Announced to all supported devices' plus New Announcement shortcut (step 5) — prove delivery, then repeat.
avoid: Implicit 'all supported devices' broadcast with no room vs device picker on these screens (step 5) — Essentials needs explicit room vs simulator (manikin) targets.
mobbin:4a2af2e6-86bb-4af2-a8cf-dc106008e.fit: Shapes the intercom / announcement panel outside SRV: compose (type/voice/preset) then confirm delivery; add separate room vs simulator targets before send.
